name: Whitethorn
oneLiner: A small-animal practice on Whitethorn Green — the recovery measured, and the walk shown rather than claimed.
paletteSeed: oat paper, a soft meadow-wash band and sloe ink (a blue-green black, never pure black), with ONE accent — haw red, the hawthorn berry — reserved for live instrument readings and nothing decorative; the name section shows the berry the red is borrowed from
typeDirection: Petrona (variable serif, warm and bookish at display scale) + Familjen Grotesk (humanist grotesk body) + DM Mono (instrument readings only) — all OFL, vendored, all portfolio-new
motionBudget: one scroll clock and no second animation system: a kinematic gait study pins while its six chapters scroll past and drive it — the dog's lameness, gait, paw-trajectory loops, footfall trail and readouts all run off the same clock; the belt and trail move at the speed the dog would be travelling; reduced-motion freezes the walk and no-JS keeps every chapter's numbers in the markup; THE WINK lands at Day 84 only — the paw-prints wander up off the measured line under a note reading '(stopped to sniff something)', and the instrument then hands off to a photograph

verdict.note: First site of the landing arc (docs/landing-arc/spec.md), and the first built under the founder's s103 amendment restoring the claude-design mock in front of the pre-plan.
